displayIdentity.body: A charge and two shipwrecked names close the chapter. I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare, of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
